sources.title: LFM2-24B-A2B: Scaling Up the LFM2 Architecture
sources.evidence: February 24, 2026 public release of the open-weight LFM2 instruct checkpoint. Reports nominal 24B total and 2.3B active, hybrid gated short convolutions/GQA, 40 layers, 64 experts with top-4 routing, and no reasoning traces.

sources.title: LFM2-24B-A2B model card
sources.evidence: Exact-model comparison column gives 24B total, 2.3B active, 30 convolution plus 10 attention layers, 32,768 context and LFM Open License v1.0. Text generation instruct model; includes native function-calling instructions.

sources.title: LFM2-24B-A2B released checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Lfm2MoeForCausalLM, BF16, 40 layers, hidden size 2048, 64 experts with 4 selected, 2 dense layers, expert intermediate size 1536, vocabulary 65,536. max_position_embeddings is 128000 with default RoPE, in conflict with the documented 32K window.

sources.title: LFM Open License v1.0
sources.evidence: Repository license names Liquid AI, Inc. as licensor. Provides weight-use and redistribution rights subject to conditions, including commercial-revenue restrictions; it is a custom license.

sources.title: LFM2.5-24B-A2B: Built for Fast On-Device Agents
sources.evidence: October 13 successor announcement explicitly contrasts the original LFM2-24B-A2B with LFM2.5: predecessor context 32,768, successor 131,072; successor is reasoning-only unlike predecessor, retains hybrid 40-layer/64-expert/top-4 architecture and expands vocabulary.

sources.title: LFM2-24B-A2B documentation
sources.evidence: Retained exact-model documentation gives 32K context, MoE architecture and native function calling; now labels the model deprecated in favor of LFM2.5-24B-A2B.

sources.title: LFM2-24B-A2B BF16 safetensors header
sources.evidence: Read only bytes 0-7 and 8-978039 via bounded HTTP Range requests. Header has 7,610 tensors: 23,843,659,008 BF16 weight elements plus 2,432 F32 routing-bias buffer elements. Embedding appears once, no separate lm_head, quantization scales or auxiliary heads.

sources.title: LFM2 MoE Transformers implementation at v5.0.0rc1
sources.evidence: Version matches the checkpoint configuration. Registers expert_bias as a buffer, declares lm_head tied to model.embed_tokens, and implements convolution/attention blocks with sparse experts and learned router weights.

sources.title: LFM2 MoE configuration implementation at v5.0.0rc1
sources.evidence: Defaults tie_word_embeddings to true; constructor forwards that setting. max_position_embeddings defaults to 128000 as a possible implementation sequence length, which does not establish the exact checkpoint training window.

sources.title: LFM2 Technical Report
sources.evidence: November 28, 2025 report describes LFM2 hybrid convolution/GQA architecture but only the earlier 350M-8.3B models. It predates this 24B release, so its sibling counts are not transferred.

name.note: Canonical developer model name; this is the original LFM2 instruct release, not LFM2.5, Base or a quantized derivative.

family.note: LFM2 is the developer-stated family; liquid is the broader vendor label.

release_date.note: Dated first-party announcement explicitly makes the checkpoint publicly available that day; subsequent repository/template updates are not new releases.

open_weights.note: Publicly downloadable original checkpoint; custom-license restrictions do not negate weight availability.

license.note: Custom LFM license with commercial-revenue conditions; not an unrestricted open-source license.

parameters_b.note: Complete unique learned count: 23,843,661,440 stored elements minus 2,432 expert-bias buffer elements = 23,843,659,008. Count tied input/output weights once. Header contains BF16 learned weights, no quantization scales or auxiliary heads. Developer rounds this to 24B.

active_parameters_b.note: Use the developer detailed nominal 2.3B per forward pass, rather than rounded A2B shorthand. Header cross-check: 0.892427520B nonexpert weights + 22.951231488B expert weights × 4/64 = 2.326879488B, counting the shared embedding/head once. This corroborates the published rounded figure, not a new separately specified active-count convention.

architecture.note: Sparse MoE within a hybrid backbone: 30 gated short-convolution and 10 GQA layers; first two feed-forward layers dense, then 64 routed experts selecting four. The moe catalog classification is retained, with hybrid detail recorded explicitly.

context_window.note: Retain the exact-model documented 32,768 tokens. Config max_position_embeddings=128000 is not proof of trained/validated context extension. The later first-party successor announcement explicitly extends predecessor 32,768 to 131,072 only for LFM2.5.

modalities.note: Text-generation checkpoint with token embedding and causal language-model head; no vision/audio components. Other LFM2 multimodal variants are separate.

reasoning.note: Developer explicitly describes this instruct checkpoint as lacking reasoning traces; LFM2.5 successor adds reasoning-only behavior. Ordinary problem-solving ability is not a dedicated thinking mode.

tool_call.note: Exact-model card provides tool declarations, native call tokens, execution-result turns and final responses; retained docs explicitly confirm native function calling.

description.value: Open-weight LFM2 instruct language model with hybrid gated convolutions and grouped-query attention, sparse MoE routing, a 32,768-token context window and native function calling.
description.note: Replaces generic efficiency marketing with supported architecture, context and capability details; preserves open-weight instruct identity.

patch.notes: Original February 24, 2026 LFM2 instruct checkpoint; now deprecated in favor of LFM2.5. 24B is nominal: complete learned count is 23.843659008B, excluding 2,432 routing-bias buffer elements and counting tied embeddings once. Developer reports 2.3B active per token. Hybrid short-convolution/GQA backbone with sparse MoE routing. Documented context is 32,768 despite config max_position_embeddings=128000; the 131,072 context and reasoning-only behavior belong to the later LFM2.5 successor. Custom LFM Open License v1.0 has commercial-use conditions.

summary: Verified all 14 fields from the exact release, model card, configuration, bounded weight header and implementation. Correct active parameters 2 → 2.3B and nominal total 24 → exact unique learned 23.843659008B; normalize name/family and clarify hybrid MoE description. Preserve February 24 release, 32,768 context, custom license, text-only modalities, tool calling and non-thinking instruct behavior. Recorded the config/context discrepancy and excluded later LFM2.5 specifications. No full weights downloaded.
